newsitem.title: UK: NWE oil products mixed,gas oil hit by mild weather.
newsitem.headline: NWE oil products mixed,gas oil hit by mild weather.

text.p: NWE oil products were mixed in lacklustre trade on Friday, traders said.
Gas oil lost up to $4 as weaker premiums linked up with a late drop on IPE futures. Mild weather continues to dog demand.
Gasoline was relatively steady with a fairly healthy turnover in Eurograde barges around the $204/$206 fob ARA range.
Naphtha was steady with a large cargo heard traded at $225 cif and a 10,000 tonne parcel done at $215.50.
High sulphur barges were steady to firmer. Low sulphur cargoes also gained by around $1 to talk at $99/$100 fob NWE.
